- query_metrics: Use to measure the size and onset of a signal (5xx, P99 latency, throughput, cost) in a window ending now.
  parameters (JSON Schema): {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"service":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Service (or account, in cost scenarios) to query"},"metric":{"type":"string","enum":["http_5xx_rate","p99_latency_ms","request_rate","daily_cost_usd","projected_monthly_cost_usd"],"description":"Metric to query"},"window":{"type":"string","enum":["15m","30m","60m","24h","7d"],"description":"Window ending now"}},"required":["service","metric","window"],"additionalProperties":false}
- query_logs: Use to see a service's most frequent error or warning messages, grouped, with counts and versions.
  parameters (JSON Schema): {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"service":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Service whose logs will be read"},"level":{"type":"string","enum":["ERROR","WARN"],"description":"Minimum level of interest"},"window":{"type":"string","enum":["15m","30m","60m","24h","7d"],"description":"Window ending now"},"limit":{"description":"Maximum number of message groups (default 3)","type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":5}},"required":["service","level","window"],"additionalProperties":false}
- list_deploys: Use to correlate the onset of a problem with recent deploys of the service and to learn the previous version.
  parameters (JSON Schema): {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"service":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Service whose deploys will be listed"},"sinceMinutes":{"description":"How many minutes to look back (default 10080, 7 days)","type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":10080}},"required":["service"],"additionalProperties":false}
- audit_cloud_inventory: Use to find idle resources (unattached volume, unassociated IP, instance with low CPU) and the computed monthly savings for each one.
  parameters (JSON Schema): {"$schema":"https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema","type":"object","properties":{"account":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"Cloud account to audit"}},"required":["account"],"additionalProperties":false}
